vulnerability.name: CVE-2025-8869
vulnerability.description: pip tarfile fallback extraction symlink handling

statements.impact_statement: The pip package code (/venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pip/) and pip CLI binaries (/venv/bin/pip, pip3, pip3.13) are removed during the container build stage. Only pip's .dist-info metadata directory is retained so SCA scanners can identify the package. At runtime `import pip` raises ModuleNotFoundError and no pip binary is present. The runtime base is distroless (no shell, no package manager) and the entrypoint is /venv/bin/compose-lint running as nonroot UID 65532, so the vulnerable code is both physically absent from the image and unreachable by execution path.

The distroless runtime (no shell, nonroot entrypoint /venv/bin/compose-lint) makes the code both absent and unreachable.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-8643
vulnerability.description: pip treats console_scripts and gui_scripts entry point names as paths

statements.impact_statement: The affected code is pip's install-time entry point writer in /venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pip/, which is removed during the container build stage; only the .dist-info metadata directory is retained so SCA scanners can identify pip. The only installs pip performed were of hash-pinned packages from requirements.lock and the wheel built from this checkout, so no untrusted package metadata reached it. At runtime `import pip` raises ModuleNotFoundError and no pip binary is present. The distroless runtime (no shell, no package manager, nonroot entrypoint /venv/bin/compose-lint) makes the code both absent and unreachable.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-13346
vulnerability.description: pip mishandles doubly-encoded package URLs returned by indexes

statements.impact_statement: The affected code is pip's index URL resolver in /venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pip/, which is removed during the container build stage; only the .dist-info metadata directory is retained so SCA scanners can identify pip. The image never contacts a package index at runtime: there is no pip code, no pip binary, no shell and no package manager, and the entrypoint is /venv/bin/compose-lint running as nonroot UID 65532. The vulnerable code is both physically absent and unreachable by execution path.
